---
title: "Simulate LM data"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}
sim_lm <- function(){
  n_obs <- round(runif(1, min = 10, max = 80))
  int <- round(runif(1, min = -100, max = 100))
  sigma <- abs(int * round(runif(1, min = 1, max = 10)))  
  # ^ mult resid SD by int to get variability of the right magnitude
  slp <- round(runif(1, min = -10, max = 10))
  
  df <- tibble(
    x = 1:n_obs,
    error = rnorm(n_obs, mean = 0, sd = sigma),
    y = int + (slp * x) + error
  )
  
  m <- lm(y ~ x, data = df)
  list(m)  # return as list so that we end up with a list of lists (ie list of models)
}

# x <- do.call(sim_lm, args = list(seed = c(1, 2)))

set.seed(1)
models <- replicate(12, sim_lm())
```


## component-residual plots

```{r}
lapply(models, car::crPlots)
```
